verdict.rationale: Unified build, deploy, and runtime logs are a fair question for a hosting and deploy platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions build logs, deploy logs, function or runtime logs, or a consolidated log view. The closest item (netlify-docs-17) covers performance tracking and visitor and team behavior, which is analytics rather than log viewing, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view all my build, deploy, and runtime logs in one place
